task: Land on start screen and begin without moderator explanation.
success_definition: Tester names immediate goal and starts a campaign in <=60 seconds.

task: Choose/confirm opening contract and make first action.
success_definition: Tester understands what is fixed versus chosen and takes first meaningful action.

task: Perform two freeform actions including one that rejects a suggested hook.
success_definition: GM follows player action before returning to any soft offer.

task: Acquire/use/check an item, then attempt kit contradiction.
success_definition: Tester can find kit truth and sees a fair correction or constraint.

task: Make a difficult action/combat check and use Why? or receipt.
success_definition: Tester correctly explains why outcome happened using UI affordance.

task: Make a durable player correction and revisit it after one scene.
success_definition: Tester believes correction is permanent and can locate provenance.

task: Start a second engine from fresh state.
success_definition: Tester differentiates engine vibe without losing core rules clarity.

task: Decline or ignore a prompt; pursue an unrelated objective.
success_definition: No forced quest acceptance; player can describe what happened.

task: Switch voice profile; repeat comparable decision.
success_definition: Tester notices diction shift only and sees no fact/maths shift.

task: Enter a disallowed/unsafe request for selected mode.
success_definition: Boundary is clear, non-shaming, and preserves a playable alternative.

task: Return to first campaign/save and ask recap/what next/why.
success_definition: Tester locates current objective, remembered fact, and reason without reading a manual.
Tester supplies spontaneous summary of trust/continuity experience.
